idea-plugin.name: Configuration Sense
idea-plugin.description:
Autocomplete and validation for App settings and Connection strings in .NET projects.

Completion is offered inside ConfigurationManager.AppSettings, ConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings, the IConfiguration indexer and the GetSection, GetValue and GetConnectionString calls of Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration. A key that no configuration file defines is reported as a warning at the same call sites, so a typo is caught in the editor rather than at run time.

Settings are read from:

  • app.config and web.config, following configSource attributes out to external files
  • appsettings.json, flattened to colon-separated paths such as Logging:LogLevel:Default
  • User secrets, resolved through the project's UserSecretsId
  • Transforms and other dependent files, such as web.Release.config and appsettings.Development.json

A configuration file under a different name is picked up once it is registered on the Configuration Sense settings page, under Languages & Frameworks in Rider and under Environment in ReSharper. Only .json and .xml files can be added.

The plugin analyzes C# only.

For more information visit the project repository.
